_comment: Centralized data source configuration. To update data for a new year, run: python scripts/update_data.py --year YYYY

acs.label: American Community Survey (ACS 5-Year)
acs.description: Fetched automatically from the Census Bureau API.

census_variables.B02009_001E: Black or African American alone or in combination
census_variables.B02012_001E: Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone or in combination

snap.label: SNAP Benefits
snap.description: SNAP benefit data must be obtained manually from Hawaii DHS or USDA FNS reports.
snap.instructions: Download SNAP household and benefit data from Hawaii DHS (https://humanservices.hawaii.gov/bessd/snap/) or USDA FNS state data. Save CSVs to data/processed/snap_benefits/ following the naming pattern below. Required columns: geoid, snap_household_rate, snap_benefit_annual_per_household, snap_benefits_annual_total.

cep.label: Community Eligibility Provision (CEP) Schools
cep.description: CEP eligibility data must be obtained from the Hawaii Department of Education.
cep.instructions: Download the CEP school list from the Hawaii DOE or USDA FNS CEP database (https://www.fns.usda.gov/cnd/community-eligibility). Update data/raw/schools_list.csv and data/raw/cep_schools.csv, then run: python scripts/process_cep_data.py && python scripts/match_schools_to_districts.py. This regenerates the files in data/processed/cep_schools/.

alice.label: ALICE (Asset Limited, Income Constrained, Employed)
alice.description: United For ALICE Hawaii data sheet (2026 report, data year 2024): the share of households that are ALICE, above the poverty level but below the cost of basics. Counties as published, the state as their sum; House and Senate districts from its ZIP code figures, allocated with Geocorr 2022 ZIP-to-district factors and scaled to each county's totals.
alice.instructions: Download the Hawaii data sheet from https://www.unitedforalice.org/state-overview/hawaii into data/raw/alice/, set SOURCE and YEAR in scripts/build_alice.py and run it (it writes data/ALICE By Geography ({year}).xlsx with sheets State, Counties, House, Senate), then set year here and run scripts/build_static/02_build_layer_geojsons.py.

tax_credits.label: IRS Statistics of Income
tax_credits.description: IRS Statistics of Income, tax year 2023: the county data for the state and counties. Districts use the latest ZIP code data (2022), allocated by 2020 population with Geocorr 2022 ZIP-to-district factors and scaled to each county's 2023 totals. The CTC is the refundable credit (additional child tax credit). The state EITC is estimated at 40% of the federal credit, Hawaii's rate from 2023, and checked against the Department of Taxation's EITC report.
tax_credits.instructions: For a new year of SOI county data, put its Hawaii rows (<yy>incyallnoagi_hi.csv) and the Department of Taxation's EITC report tables for the same year (act107_earnedincome_txcredit_<year>_tables.xlsx) in data/raw/tax_credits/ (sources in the README there) and set YEAR in scripts/build_tax_credits.py; for a new year of SOI ZIP code data (<yy>zp12hi.xlsx, plus that year's county rows), set ZIP_YEAR. Run the script, then scripts/build_static/02_build_layer_geojsons.py. The ZIP-to-district crosswalks in data/raw/crosswalks/ change only with district lines.

medicaid.label: Medicaid Enrollment (MedQuest, ACS-calibrated)
medicaid.description: Administrative Medicaid managed-care enrollment from Hawaii MedQuest, calibrated to ACS table C27007 to reach legislative-district granularity. State/county rates are pure MedQuest / ACS population; House/Senate districts rake the ACS Medicaid-coverage shape to each MedQuest county control total. medicaid_rate flows into the merged GeoJSON via a dedicated MedicaidDataLoader (DataType.MEDICAID; data_source 'medicaid' in variables.json), decoupled from the ACS CSVs so an ACS refresh cannot blank it.
medicaid.instructions: Download the latest annual enrollment report (Managed Care By Island table) from https://medquest.hawaii.gov/en/resources/reports.html. Transcribe the 12 monthly island counts into data/raw/medquest_enrollment_{year}.csv (columns: island, jan..dec; each month's 6 islands must sum to that month's 'Medicaid Managed Care Total'). Update MEDQUEST_YEAR in scripts/build_medicaid_2024.py, then run: python scripts/build_medicaid_2024.py. The medicaid CSVs are independent of the ACS CSVs, so an ACS refresh does not affect them; re-run only for a new MedQuest report (or to refresh the ACS population denominators).
